build_stable_diffusion_pipeline_from_sin: build a StableDiffusionPipeline from a single .ckpt or .safetensors checkpoint file hosted on Hugging Face Hub
load_single_file_sub_model: load a single pipeline sub-model such as a UNet, scheduler, or tokenizer from a checkpoint file
create_diffusers_clip_model_from_ldm: create a diffusers-compatible CLIP text encoder model from a legacy LDM checkpoint
create_diffusers_t5_model_from_checkpoin: create a diffusers-compatible T5 text encoder model from a checkpoint containing T5 weights
infer_pipeline_config_dict: infer the pipeline component configuration dictionary from a pipeline class signature and type hints
